working_tree_changes: Upload measurement refactor; apply netband-source.patch to the base revision before building.
environment: Linux x86_64 host connected over 5 GHz Wi-Fi (5765 MHz at startup); router/AP, firmware and location unspecified
server: Same operator-authorized Akamai Cloud NDT7 server for both clients
order: Netband first in odd pairs; reference first in even pairs
netband_measurement: Download: client binary application bytes / client elapsed time. Upload: server TCPInfo.BytesReceived / TCPInfo.ElapsedTime.
reference_measurement: Download uses last client AppInfo snapshot including text; upload uses server TCPInfo
wifi_snapshot: Before measurements; not continuous association monitoring
